test_is_retryable_error: test the _is_retryable_error function to check if error strings match transient network error patterns
test_is_timeout_error: test the _is_timeout_error function to distinguish delivery-ambiguous timeouts from connection errors
test_send_with_retry_success: test _send_with_retry returns success immediately when the first send attempt succeeds
test_send_with_retry_network: test _send_with_retry retries on transient network errors and returns success on retry
test_send_with_retry_exhausted: test _send_with_retry sends a delivery-failure notice after all retries are exhausted
